title: Core Default Gate Stability Review Checklist

items.label: Capture Core head, cleanliness, repository agreement, and prior timeout evidence before changing Core.
items.evidenceTarget: Core AGENTS.md, current git status, current head, and the previous cross-repository compatibility timeout evidence are reviewed.

items.label: Run the default Core gate in the Core lane to determine whether the timeout reproduces under current conditions.
items.evidenceTarget: Core package.json#scripts.check output distinguishes a default-gate pass, repeatable failure, or flaky/timing-sensitive result.

items.label: Inspect the failing test, related helpers, Vitest configuration, and recent changes, then run focused probes for the suspected root cause.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused command outputs and code references classify whether the timeout is caused by suite load, test shape, leaked state, or another identified source.

items.label: Implement a minimal Core change only if the root cause warrants a product or test adjustment.
items.evidenceTarget: Core diff and focused regression evidence show the fix targets the identified root cause, or the lane records an explicit no-change blocker.

items.label: Verify the Core gate in the lane and on main, then register the bounded Project Control evidence without promoting compatibility truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Evidence target evidence-core-default-gate-stability-review-2026-08-27 records the Core commit, command results, supported claim, risks, and intentionally unpromoted truth.
